name: Clear Spyglass - Full Screen Zoom
summary: Removes the spyglass scope overlay so the full screen stays usable while you zoom.
body:
**Clear Spyglass - Full Screen Zoom** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- The black scope circle and its border are removed from the spyglass view
- Zoom behaviour is untouched - only the overlay texture changes

### Why players use it
- You keep full peripheral vision while scouting, so you are not blind while zoomed
- Great for spotting players, bases and terrain from far away

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)
